item_name: Rothco Vintage Navy Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Navy Low Profile Cap is crafted from durable, 100% washed brushed cotton twill for a comfortable fit and features an embroidered Navy insignia on the front panel. Officially licensed by the U.S. Navy, this adjustable cap with hook & loop closure combines timeless style with military pride
